name: EVAT-Website
description: Monorepo for the Electric Vehicle Application Tool (EVAT)

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:python"  --names=client,server,python --kill-others
scripts.dev:python: cd "server/python-services" && uv run --locked python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5000 --reload
scripts.dev:reliability: cd "server/python-services" && uv run --locked python -m uvicorn reliability_scoring_api.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8003
